scope: The inspected scalar benchmark promotion and score functions only; not an audit of all repository selection code.
findings: time_case retains the minimum of 5 wall-clock samples.
rotate_promoted_cases sorts by elapsed nanoseconds, rotates the worst eligible historical cases into one promoted group, and truncates that group to 100.
score_promoted_cases averages current timing probes across the promoted group.

The inspected selection path does not shuffle independent case dimensions and successively filter candidate survivors. It does not maintain an independent promoted population for each private Real representation.
The existing lexicase wording in the scalar fuzz README and generated score description exceeds the behavior of these inspected functions.

primary_algorithm_reference.title: Solving Uncompromising Problems with Lexicase Selection
primary_algorithm_reference.paraphrase: For each selection, shuffle case order, retain candidates with the best value on the next case, and continue until one survives or cases are exhausted; select randomly among remaining ties.
